newsitem.title: UK: Pilkington plans no major disposals.
newsitem.headline: Pilkington plans no major disposals.

text.p: British glassmaker Pilkington Plc said on Thursday that it has no plans for any further major disposals following the recent sale of its Barnes-Hind contact lens business.

"That (Barnes-Hind) was the last of our non-core businesses...although we will have some smaller disposals they won't be of any major magnitude," Roger Leverton, chief executive of Pilkington told Reuters Financial Television.
Pilkington announced earlier that half year pre-tax profits slipped to 75 million pounds after an exceptional charge of seven million pounds on the sale of Barnes-Hind.
The profit figure compares with 104 million previously and was at the low end of market expectations. Pilkington maintained its interim dividend at 1.75p.
Pilkington sold its Barnes Hind Contact Lens business to Wesley Jessen Corp of the U.S. for $79 million.
